default.question: Why does this starter avoid jQuery and animation libraries?
default.answer: Removing heavy JavaScript libraries keeps asset payloads under 15 KB and delivers 95+ mobile Google Lighthouse performance out of the box.

default.question: Can marketers edit pages without touching code?
default.answer: Yes. All sections use native HubSpot drag-and-drop areas with brand-locked spacing and typography tokens.
